caption: AI plans can miss priorities. Use a small, repeatable checklist to ensure real prioritization. Which prompt will you start with today? #AIinBusiness #Productivity #DecisionMaking

slides.title: Weak AI plans, smarter workflow
slides.body: Your AI plan can misprioritize. This post gives five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, verify, and refine planning.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Input placeholders: {goals}, {tasks}, {deadlines}. Output: ranked tasks with scores 1-10 and brief rationale.

slides.title: 2. Clarify outcomes
slides.body: Task: convert each task into concrete outcomes with success criteria. Placeholder: {desired_outcomes}. Output: list of outcome statements.

slides.title: 3. Sequence plan
slides.body: Task: build a 2-week sequence; include durations; placeholder: {week_constraints}. Output: Gantt-like plan with dates.

slides.title: 4. Check risks
slides.body: Task: identify prioritization risks; Output: risks with mitigations; Placeholder: {risk_factors}.

slides.title: 5. Validate constraints
slides.body: Task: test plan against constraints; Output: pass/fail verdict and adjustments; Placeholder: {constraints}.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Treat AI as a drafting assistant, not the final decision. Use prompts to build a validated planning workflow.
